finding_summary: Keep point prediction plus UNKNOWN as the fail-closed generation-1 default when no independently public outcome vocabulary exists.
Report coverage and selective error/risk separately so always-abstain cannot game accuracy.
If a public categorical outcome vocabulary exists, add bounded dependency-free Brier score; do not derive vocabulary from evaluator-private fixture nodes/transitions.
Seal prediction identity before WP800 evaluator advancement and score only against the subsequently materialized public ObservationView.
Bind baseline fit-split identity separately from held-out identity; reject overlap/aliasing.
Same-process Python whitelisting is a cooperative provenance fence, not adversarial secrecy; hostile-plugin secrecy would require a separate trust boundary.
external_basis: Wang et al. 2026 arXiv:2606.05241 (structural contamination analogy only)
